title: Test the remaining uncarried-test reasons and both fallback reasons
outcome: Every reason the uncarried-test closure line can give is asserted by a regression test, so the reasons' order and the fallback wiring cannot regress silently.
acceptance: Table-driven regression tests assert the closure line's reason for: a check of another grant at the turn's close (ENGRAM_UNCARRIED_OTHER_GRANT), a cached close in a named root (ENGRAM_UNCARRIED_UNRESOLVED_CLOSE), a missing runtime token, a delegated session, a target outside the named root, and an outstanding-work fence.
disposal_reason: Its tests are absorbed into w-2dcd927cfb4d's C3 (concurred by Termal::Fable2, dcac180e).
